title: MemoryEvent
description: ONE simple INF event shape. Public-safe teaching schema — no personal paths. Layer 15 adds optional temporal / supersede fields.

id.description: Stable id for this event (uuid or slug).

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the event happened.

refs.description: Optional file paths or URLs relative to YOUR store root — never hardcode another user's machine.

valid_from.description: Layer 15: when this record became current.

valid_to.description: Layer 15: when it stopped being current; null = still live.

supersedes.description: Layer 15: id or relative path this record replaces. No silent delete.

superseded_by.description: Layer 15: id or path of the newer record (set on the old row).
